## Frequently asked questions
### Is there any setup fee for using WhatsApp API?
YCloud does not charge a setup fee. We will provide you with the necessary introduction and get you ready to start using YCloud, and if you need further assistance after 30 days of registration, we will charge a minimum plan fee
### If WhatsApp is free, what's WhatsApp message pricing meaning?
While regular use of WhatsApp is free, businesses that grow their business using the WhatsApp Business API will incur charges for sending customer messages. WhatsApp pricing is based on the customer's country code and your message template.
Pricing article
### Is WhatsApp fee included in YCloud subscription?
WhatsApp fee is not included in the YCloud subscription. However, you will be able to top up your wallet on our platform and YCloud will automatically deduct the fees incurred in your wallet at the WhatsApp rate.
### Do YCloud's pricing plans include taxes?
No, YCloud subscription fees and any additional requirements are exclusive of taxes
### How long does the free version last?
The free version is valid forever, and you don't need to provide us with your credit card information to access the free version.
You can experience almost all the features of YCloud and use the WhatsApp messaging API without restrictions. We only charge for WhatsApp conversations.
### How do I upgrade or cancel my plan?
**Cancel：** Before the end of the billing cycle, you will continue to have access to the features and limitations of your plan. The subscription will be automatically canceled after the plan expires. Additionally, we do not refund any payments made for your existing subscription or wallet.
**Upgrade：** go to the Billing > Subscription of the Backend, select “Upgrade” button , and choose a more appropriate plan.
### How does YCloud protect my data?
YCloud prioritizes your data security through a combination of encryption, access controls, and security audits. Our ISO 27001 certification further highlights our commitment to maintaining top information security standards.
### Can I add additional users for free?
Yes! Simply leave a review on [G2](https://www.g2.com/contributor/existing-clients-30c7bf3f-640d-49ff-b76e-58c6547d6445) and [TrustPilot](https://www.trustpilot.com/evaluate/www.ycloud.com) that share your experience with YCloud, take a screenshot and send it to Online Customer Service to add additional users for free.
